// A spatial blob system: the field value at a point is the summed influence
// of all balls minus Threshold, so the zero level set is the blob surface.
type MetaBallSystem3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Balls: Array<MetaBall3D>;
    Threshold: Number;
}
